title: Best vitamin C serum I've ever used!
text: Been using this for 3 weeks and my skin is visibly brighter. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly. No sticky feeling at all. My pigmentation spots are fading. Worth every rupee!
author: PriyaS_Mumbai

title: Good product, decent packaging
text: The serum works well on my oily skin. Noticed brightness improvement after 2 weeks. Only giving 4 stars because the dropper sometimes gets stuck. Product itself is great though.
author: AnjaliR_Bangalore

title: Perfect for Indian summers
text: Lightweight, non-greasy, and keeps my skin hydrated all day. I've tried Minimalist and Dot & Key before but this one is superior. The gel texture is perfect for our humid climate. Highly recommend!
author: SnehaM_Chennai

title: Woke up with glowing skin
text: This kumkumadi cream is magic! Applied it before sleeping and woke up with such soft glowing skin. The saffron fragrance is divine. Better than Forest Essentials at half the price.
author: MeghnaK_Delhi

title: Average results, expected more
text: Used it for a month but dark spots are still there. Maybe slight improvement but nothing dramatic. The consistency is nice though. Might need to use it longer. Mamaearth's version worked faster for me tbh.
author: RiyaT_Pune

text: omg this serum is everything!! 🧡✨ my skin has never looked this good. dropping this in my AM routine forever 💛
author: @skincare_priya

title: Caused breakouts
text: I have sensitive combination skin. This moisturizer caused small bumps on my forehead after 4 days of use. Had to stop. Maybe it's not suitable for acne-prone skin. Disappointed because the reviews were so good.
author: KavyaP_Hyderabad

title: Good but pricey
text: The cream is really good and I can see results. But at this price point, I expected a bigger jar. 50g finishes in about 3 weeks. The quality is great though, just wish it was more affordable or came in a bigger size.
author: DivyaS_Kolkata

title: Received damaged product - leaked completely
text: Very disappointed!! The entire box was wet when I received it. The serum bottle cap was loose and half the product had leaked out. The packaging needs serious improvement. This is not acceptable for a premium product. Want full refund.
author: ArjunV_Jaipur

title: Packaging disaster - bottle cracked
text: The glass bottle arrived cracked. Serum was all over the packaging. How can you ship glass bottles with such poor bubble wrap? This is the second time I'm ordering and second time it arrived damaged. Never ordering again.
author: PrateekG_Lucknow

title: Leaking bottle AGAIN
text: Third order and THIRD time the bottle arrived leaking. The cap design is fundamentally flawed. The product inside is great but what's the point if it arrives half empty? GlowNest please fix your packaging ASAP!
author: NehaSh_Noida

title: Product leaked during shipping
text: Got the serum today but the box was stained. Opened it and found the bottle cap wasn't sealed properly. About 30% product was lost. The serum itself is nice but packaging quality is really really poor. Seal it better pls.
author: AmitK_Ahmedabad

title: Complaint: Damaged product received
text: Order #GN-78234. I received the Vitamin C serum today and the entire package was wet. The bottle cap was not sealed and the product leaked everywhere. This is unacceptable for a Rs 899 product. I demand a replacement or full refund immediately. This is the worst packaging I've seen from any skincare brand.
author: RajeshP_Indore

title: Broken seal, oxidized serum
text: The seal was broken when I received it. The serum has turned dark orange/brown which means its oxidized and useless now. The outer box had no damage so the bottle was packed with a broken seal. Quality control issue at factory level. Very disappointing GlowNest.
author: SureshB_Nagpur

text: yo @glownest_official whats going on with ur packaging?? my serum arrived completely leaked out 😤 this is like the 4th person i know who had this issue. fix it!!
author: @beautywithneha

title: Cap design is horrible
text: The dropper cap doesnt close properly. Even after closing tight, the serum leaks if the bottle tilts. I keep it upright but during travel it leaked in my bag and ruined everything. Please redesign the cap. The product formula is actually good but useless if it keeps leaking.
author: VandanaM_Bhopal

title: Slow but steady results
text: After 6 weeks of consistent use, my acne marks have noticeably faded. Not an overnight miracle but it works. The pump dispenser is much better than the dropper bottles. Skin texture has also improved. Will repurchase.
author: FatimaN_Mumbai

title: Reordered through the app - love it
text: This is my 4th repurchase. The moisturizer is incredible for Delhi winters and summers both. Light enough for summer, hydrating enough for winter with AC. The app makes reordering so easy. 10/10
author: TanyaG_Delhi

title: Allergic reaction - red rashes
text: I got severe redness and itching after first use. My face was covered in red patches by morning. Had to see a dermatologist. I have sensitive skin and there's no proper allergen warning on the product. This is a safety concern. Please add better ingredient warnings.
author: ShreyaD_Pune

title: Finally something that works!
text: After trying countless products for my post-acne marks, this is the ONE. 8 weeks in and my marks have reduced by like 70%. The 10% niacinamide concentration is perfect. Better results than The Ordinary which I used for 3 months with barely any change.
author: IshitaR_Gurgaon

title: HG product for brightening
text: This has become my holy grail morning serum. Combines well under sunscreen. No pilling, no irritation. My skin tone is more even after 1 month. The 20% vitamin c concentration really works. Better than Plum and SkinCeuticals dupe!
author: AnupamaK_Kochi

title: Pure quality coconut oil
text: You can tell this is genuinely cold-pressed. The aroma is fresh and natural, solidifies in winter which is a good sign. Using it for cooking and hair both. Much better than the supermarket brands. Will buy the bigger bottle next time.
author: LakshmiV_Trivandrum

title: Good oil but cap leaks
text: The oil quality is excellent, no doubt. But the flip-top cap doesn't close properly and oil leaked in my kitchen cabinet. Please improve the cap design. The oil itself deserves 5 stars.
author: RaviK_Coimbatore

title: Tastes like real honey from village
text: This honey reminds me of the honey my grandmother used to get from local beekeepers. Thick, rich, and not overly sweet like commercial brands. The crystallization is natural and expected. Love it with warm water every morning.
author: SudhirM_Varanasi

title: Doubt if this is actually organic
text: The honey tastes ok but I'm not convinced it's truly organic. The certification details on the label are hard to read and the QR code on the bottle doesn't work. For the premium price charged, I expect better transparency. Also the batch number was missing.
author: VikramJ_Chandigarh

title: Perfect breakfast option
text: Ive been looking for a healthy breakfast alternative and this quinoa millet mix is perfect. Cooks in 15 mins, tastes nutty and filling. My kids also like it with some jaggery. Great source of protein. Ordering 2 more packs!
author: AnitaS_Bangalore

title: Found small stones in the mix
text: Quality control issue - I found 2-3 small stones/pebbles in the mix. Had to manually sort through the entire packet before cooking. This is not acceptable for a premium organic brand. The taste was fine otherwise but quality check needs improvement.
author: DeepakR_Patna

title: Golden milk made easy
text: Perfect blend of turmeric, black pepper, and cinnamon. Just add hot milk and its ready. The taste is warm and comforting. My whole family drinks it before bed now. Much better than making from scratch. The zip lock packaging keeps it fresh.
author: ManishaB_Jaipur

title: Too much sugar added
text: I bought this thinking it would be a healthy option but the second ingredient listed is SUGAR. Why would you add sugar to a turmeric latte premix? Defeats the entire purpose of buying organic health product. Very misleading marketing. Returned it.
author: NikhilT_Mumbai

title: Best coconut oil in India
text: I've tried Coco Soul, KLF Nirmal, and several others. PureRoots is by far the best cold-pressed coconut oil available online. The extraction process preserves all the nutrients. Great for oil pulling too. My skin and hair both improved since switching.
author: JayaP_Mangalore

title: Complaint: Received expired product
text: Dear PureRoots team, I received my order of Organic Honey today (Order #PR-45621) and the manufacturing date shows Jan 2024 with expiry Aug 2025. The product will expire in less than a month! For the price of Rs 650 I expect fresh stock. Please send replacement with recent manufacturing date. Regards, Mohan Kumar.
author: MohanK_Dehradun

title: Good product, packaging could improve
text: The mix is really good quality and tastes great. However the packaging is just a simple plastic pouch - for a premium organic brand I expected better. Maybe a resealable box or jar? Also no recipe suggestions included which would be nice.
author: PreethamS_Hyderabad

text: made the golden latte with @pureroots_official premix tonight. so cozy and comforting 🥛✨ the turmeric color is beautiful. adding this to my nightly routine! #goldenmilk #ayurveda
author: @healthyeating_pooja

title: Expensive for what you get
text: The oil quality is fine but 500ml for Rs 499 is way too expensive. I can get similar quality cold pressed oil from my local store for half the price. The organic certification doesn't justify double the cost. Reducing my rating for value.
author: GaneshR_Madurai

title: Genuine raw honey
text: Good quality raw honey. Crystallization started after 2 months which confirms its not processed. Taste is slightly different from commercial honey - more floral notes. Only minus is the glass jar is heavy and not travel friendly.
author: SaritaD_Ranchi

title: Query about sourcing
text: Hello, I've been a loyal PureRoots customer for 6 months. I wanted to know where your quinoa is sourced from - is it Indian grown or imported? I prefer supporting Indian farmers. Also, are the millets single-origin? Would appreciate transparency on sourcing. Thanks, Aruna.
author: ArunaG_Mysore

title: Good but arrived late
text: Product quality is excellent but delivery took 12 days instead of promised 3-5 days. For a perishable organic product, this delay is concerning. What if it was summer and the oil degraded? Please improve logistics.
author: AshokN_Vizag

title: Replaced my chai addiction
text: I was drinking 5-6 cups of chai daily. Switched to this turmeric latte and now I have it twice a day. Feel much better, less acidity. The ashwagandha addition is a bonus. Ordering the family pack next. Thank you PureRoots!
author: KiranB_Nagpur

title: My kids love it
text: Finally a honey that actually tastes like honey! My children love it on their morning toast and with warm milk at night. The raw unprocessed quality makes me feel good about giving it to them. PureRoots has earned a lifetime customer. 👍
author: PallaviJ_Lucknow

title: Tasted stale
text: The mix I received tasted stale and had a weird off-smell when I opened the packet. The manufacturing date was 8 months ago. For grains this is ok shelf-life wise but the taste suggests improper storage. Not buying again unless quality improves.
author: RohanS_Goa

title: Finally a shampoo that works
text: I've been losing hair like crazy for 2 years. Tried everything from Dove to Head & Shoulders to Wow. This Anti-Hairfall shampoo actually reduced my hairfall noticeably in 3 weeks. The onion + biotin formula is effective. My bathroom drain has way less hair now!
author: RahulK_Delhi

title: Works well but strong smell
text: The shampoo is effective for hairfall control. My hair feels stronger after a month. But the onion smell is quite strong even with the added fragrance. It lingers for a while after washing. Maybe a milder fragrance option would be good. Otherwise great product.
author: SiddharthM_Pune

title: Silky smooth hair instantly
text: This argan oil serum is brilliant! Just 2-3 drops and my frizzy hair becomes silky smooth. Non-greasy, smells amazing, and provides heat protection for styling. Way better than the expensive salon brands. My hair stylist even asked what I'm using 😄
author: MeeraN_Mumbai

title: Patchy beard filling in slowly
text: Been using this for 5 weeks. My patchy areas are slowly filling in. Not a dramatic overnight change but consistent improvement. The oil is not too heavy and absorbs well. The minoxidil-free formula gives me peace of mind. Will continue for 3 more months.
author: VarunS_Gurgaon

title: Salon-like treatment at home
text: This keratin mask transformed my damaged colored hair. Used it twice and my hair is so soft and manageable now. The deep conditioning is comparable to salon keratin treatments. Saves me Rs 3000-4000 per salon visit. Absolutely love it.
author: AditiS_Chandigarh

title: INCREASED my hairfall!
text: This shampoo made my hairfall WORSE not better! After using it for 2 weeks my hair started falling more than before. Clumps of hair in the shower. I think the SLS or some ingredient is too harsh. Switched back to my old shampoo immediately. Very misleading claims.
author: AkashR_Bangalore

title: Hair falling more than before!!
text: Worst purchase ever. My hairfall has literally doubled since I started using this so-called anti-hairfall shampoo. I was losing maybe 30-40 strands before, now its 80-100 per wash. My scalp also feels dry and itchy. This product should be investigated. DO NOT BUY.
author: KartikP_Noida

title: Caused more hairfall and dandruff
text: Used this for 3 weeks hoping my hairfall would reduce. Instead I started getting dandruff which I never had before AND my hairfall increased. Went to dermatologist who said the product has sulfates which stripped my scalps natural oils. Anti-hairfall claims are bogus for this.
author: SameerJ_Hyderabad

title: Complaint: Adverse reaction to shampoo
text: Ticket Subject: Adverse reaction to Anti-Hairfall Shampoo. Dear UrbanMane, I've been using your Anti-Hairfall Shampoo for 10 days and my hairfall has significantly worsened. I also developed scalp irritation and redness. I believe the product contains harsh chemicals despite being marketed as gentle. I would like a full refund and I want to know what testing has been done on this product. Please respond urgently. - Deepa Sharma, Order #UM-89432
author: DeepaS_Mumbai

text: anyone else experience MORE hairfall after using @urbanmane shampoo?? i thought it was just me but seeing so many similar reviews. not cool 😡 #hairfall #scam
author: @groominggururaj

title: Good serum, slightly overpriced
text: The serum works well for taming frizz and adding shine. I use it after every wash and my hair looks salon-fresh. But Rs 599 for 50ml is a bit steep. Compared to Streax or Set Wet serums which are cheaper but this one is definitely better quality. Worth trying once.
author: NaveenD_Chennai

title: Game changer for beard growth
text: 3 months update: My beard has gone from patchy embarrassment to full thick coverage. Using this oil daily with derma roller. The combination of castor oil, jojoba, and vitamin E is perfect. My friends keep asking what I did. UrbanMane is the real deal 💪
author: AbhishekT_Delhi

title: Average results for curly hair
text: I have type 3B curly hair and was hoping this mask would define my curls. It made my hair softer but actually weighed down my curls and made them limp. I think this mask is better for straight or wavy hair. Curly girls should look for a curl-specific product.
author: ZaraN_Kolkata

title: Best hairfall shampoo in India
text: 6 weeks in and my hairfall has reduced by 70%. I was skeptical at first but this actually works. The biotin and caffeine combination is backed by science. My hair feels thicker and healthier. Way better than Tresemme and Dove anti-hairfall variants.
author: ManojK_Bhopal

title: Silicone heavy - damaged my hair long term
text: Initially my hair looked great with this serum but after 2 months I noticed my hair becoming dry and brittle. Did some research and found its loaded with dimethicone which gives illusion of smooth hair but actually causes buildup and damage. Stopped using and switching to silicone free alternative.
author: ShrutiB_Pune

text: 2 month beard journey using @urbanmane growth oil 🧔 check the before/after in my stories. Legit results no cap. Use code GROOMING20 for discount (not sponsored just sharing what works)
author: @beardedbaniya

title: Good but messy to apply
text: The mask works wonderfully for deep conditioning. My chemically treated hair feels reborn after each use. Only complaint is the jar packaging - hard to scoop out the thick cream without making a mess. A tube would be much more practical. Product quality is A+ though.
author: ReshmaK_Kochi

title: Good serum, app needs work
text: The argan serum is really good but Im reviewing through the app and the app is super slow. Takes forever to load product pages. Also the subscription option keeps bugging out. Fix the app please! Product is 5/5, app is 2/5.
author: PrakashL_Indore

title: Great formulation, glass bottle is risky
text: Love the serum formula and results. But glass bottle for e-commerce delivery is risky. Mine arrived safely but I've read so many reviews about broken/leaked bottles. Suggestion: switch to airless pump with plastic bottle. The formula deserves better packaging to match.
author: RadhikaM_Chennai

title: Multipurpose miracle oil
text: Using this for cooking, oil pulling, baby massage, and hair oil. One product does it all. The cold pressed quality means all nutrients are retained. Tried Parachute Advanced cold pressed before but PureRoots is definitely more pure and aromatic.
author: SonaliB_Pune

title: Good results with mild formula
text: Been using for 6 weeks. Hairfall reduced noticeably. Doesnt dry out scalp like some other anti hairfall shampoos. Lathers well and washes out clean. The biotin + caffeine combo is solid. Would give 5 stars but the bottle design is boring and generic looking.
author: PriyankV_Lucknow

title: Authentic taste but dissolving issue
text: The taste is really authentic and I love the spice blend. My only issue is that the powder doesnt dissolve properly in milk. You get clumps at the bottom of the cup even after stirring. Maybe make it finer or add an emulsifier. Otherwise great product for immunity.
author: PoojaM_Ahmedabad

title: Repurchasing for the 5th time
text: This is the only moisturizer I trust for my sensitive skin. No fragrance, no irritation, just pure hydration. I've tried switching to cheaper alternatives but always come back. The pump dispenser is hygienic and convenient. GlowNest please never discontinue this!
author: AnushaR_Visakhapatnam

title: Broke out in acne from this
text: Applied this oil for 1 week and got severe acne all over my jaw and cheek area. The oil is too heavy and comedogenic for my skin type. No warning on the label about potential breakouts. Had to see a dermatologist. Not suitable for acne prone skin AT ALL.
author: RonitG_Noida

title: Glass jar arrived cracked
text: The honey quality seems good but the glass jar had a hairline crack on arrival. No leaking yet but I'm worried about glass shards. For a food product this is a serious safety concern. Please use better packaging for shipping glass jars. Content seems fine otherwise.
author: AmolD_Nashik

text: my nighttime skincare routine ft @glownest_official kumkumadi cream 🌙 the saffron scent is so relaxing. been using for 2 months and my skin texture is noticeably smoother. swipe for before/after 👉
author: @skincarejunkie_riya

title: INCREDIBLE results on bleached hair
text: I bleached my hair last month and it was like straw. This keratin mask brought it back to life in just 3 uses. My hair is soft, shiny, and the elasticity is back. I use it once a week as a deep treatment. If you have chemically processed hair this is a MUST HAVE.
author: NihaarikaS_Hyderabad

title: Bulk order inquiry
text: Hi PureRoots team, I run a small Ayurvedic wellness center in Rishikesh. We go through about 10 liters of coconut oil per month for our treatments. Do you offer bulk pricing or wholesale options? We've been using your retail bottles and the quality is excellent for our massage therapies. Please share bulk order details. - Dr. Shanti Devi
author: DrShantiD_Rishikesh

title: Works better than prescription creams
text: My dermatologist had prescribed tretinoin for my dark spots but it was too harsh on my skin. Switched to this niacinamide corrector and within 6 weeks my spots faded significantly without any irritation. The 10% concentration is clinical grade. GlowNest has done their R&D right.
author: MayuriS_Nagpur

title: Yeh shampoo theek hai but not great
text: Maine 1 month use kiya. Hairfall thoda kam hua but dramtaic result nahi dikha. Foam accha hai aur smell bhi okay hai. But itne mehnga hone ke baad bhi Tresemme se zyada farak nahi pada. Maybe I need more time. Dekhte hai.
author: VishalT_Indore

title: Dupe for SkinCeuticals CE Ferulic
text: At Rs 899 this is honestly a dupe for the Rs 12,000 SkinCeuticals CE Ferulic serum. Similar vitamin C concentration, similar results. The addition of ferulic acid and vitamin E makes it a stable and effective formulation. Best budget vitamin C in India right now.
author: DrNehaG_Mumbai

title: Great for weight loss diet
text: I replaced my rice with this quinoa millet mix for lunch and lost 3 kgs in a month! Its filling, nutritious, and actually tastes good. My nutritionist also approved it. The protein content is impressive. Making upma and pulao with it - turns out delicious.
author: SwatiK_Bangalore

title: Perfect for humid Mumbai weather
text: Mumbai humidity makes my hair a frizzy mess. This argan serum is the only thing that keeps it smooth through the day. Even after getting caught in the rain my hair stays relatively manageable. The lightweight formula doesnt weigh hair down. 10/10 for humid climates.
author: ShwetaP_Mumbai

title: Good moisturizer, needs more sizes
text: The moisturizer is excellent - lightweight, fast absorbing, and keeps skin hydrated for 8+ hours. Only issue is it comes in just one size (50ml). For daily use on face and neck it finishes in 3-4 weeks. Need a 100ml or 200ml option for better value.
author: KrunalS_Surat

title: Good concept bad execution
text: Love the idea of instant golden milk but this premix has too many additives. Maltodextrin, silicon dioxide - why? Just give us pure turmeric, pepper, cinnamon blend. I can add my own milk powder and sweetener. The 'organic' label feels misleading with these additives.
author: AnkitM_Gurgaon

title: Slow but real results
text: Using for 2 months now. The patchy spots on my cheeks are slowly filling in. Not miracle speed but its genuine growth. The oil has a nice subtle scent and doesnt stain my pillow. Better than Beardo which I used earlier - that one was too greasy.
author: HarshV_Ahmedabad

title: Ancient Ayurveda meets modern skincare
text: This is what Ayurvedic skincare should be. Real kumkumadi thailam benefits in a modern cream base. The saffron, sandalwood, and manjistha combination works beautifully. My skin looks like I had a professional facial every morning. Better than Kama Ayurveda at a fraction.
author: LataR_Jaipur

title: Lifesaver for dry hair
text: Living in Rajasthan means perpetually dry hair. This keratin mask is the only thing that keeps my hair moisturized. Use it every Sunday for a deep condition session. My split ends have reduced drastically. The creamy formula is rich without being heavy.
author: PadmaD_Jodhpur

title: Not cold pressed - feels refined
text: I've used authentic cold pressed coconut oil from Kerala all my life. This does NOT taste or smell like genuine cold pressed oil. The aroma is too mild and the texture is too thin. I suspect this is refined oil being sold as cold pressed. Very disappointing at this price.
author: ThomasJ_Kottayam

title: Great for post-pregnancy marks
text: Had terrible melasma after pregnancy. This niacinamide serum has been gradually fading those stubborn marks. After 2 months of twice daily application the improvement is around 50%. Very happy with the results. Will continue for 2 more months. Safe for breastfeeding too.
author: SmritiiP_Kolkata

title: Doctor recommended
text: My trichologist recommended UrbanMane for my androgenetic alopecia. 2 months in and the results are promising. Combined with their serum the hairfall has reduced by about 60%. The DHT blocking ingredients seem to work. Only medical grade product I've seen OTC that delivers.
author: DrAnilM_Chennai

title: Good honey, bad customer service
text: The honey itself is excellent quality. But I had a query about the source of flowers and it took them 2 weeks to respond to my email. For a premium brand, customer service should be better. The product deserves 5 stars but the after-sales support pulls it down.
author: ShaileshK_Indore

title: Pahle din se hi farak dikha
text: Ek hi din mein skin brighter lag rahi thi. Maine bahut products try kiye par yeh sabse best hai. Mere dull skin pe instantly glow aata hai. Price bhi reasonable hai compared to international brands. Definitely 5 stars. Sab ko recommend karungi.
author: RuchiD_Lucknow

title: Decent but not worth the hype
text: Its an okay hair serum. Does what serums are supposed to do - adds some shine and reduces frizz. But the hype around it made me expect something extraordinary. At Rs 599 I expected premium results. L'Oreal Extraordinary Oil at Rs 350 gives similar results.
author: KaranB_Delhi

title: Perfect for diabetics
text: My doctor advised me to reduce rice and wheat. This quinoa millet mix is a fantastic alternative. Low GI, high fiber, and actually tastes pleasant. My blood sugar levels have improved since switching. The cooking instructions on the pack are helpful.
author: RajendraP_Pune

text: dry skin girlie here 🙋‍♀️ this @glownest_official moisturizer is the only thing keeping my skin alive in this AC weather. layered under sunscreen it works PERFECTLY. no white cast no greasiness just hydration 💧
author: @glowupwithsana

title: Finally confident about my beard
text: 4 months of consistent use and my beard is now full and even. The patchy areas are completely filled in. I apply it twice daily with gentle massage. The oil strengthened my existing hair and stimulated new growth. This product genuinely changed my confidence level.
author: FaisalA_Delhi

title: Ingredient query
text: Dear PureRoots, I recently purchased your Turmeric Latte Premix and noticed the ingredient list mentions 'natural flavors'. Could you please specify what these natural flavors are? My son has multiple food allergies and I need to verify each ingredient. Also, is this product processed in a facility that handles nuts? Thanks, Meera.
author: MeeraR_Bangalore

title: Pilling issue with sunscreen
text: The corrector itself might be good but it pills terribly under every sunscreen I've tried. Little white balls form on my face which looks horrible. What's the point of a dark spot treatment if you cant layer sunscreen over it? Needs reformulation for better layering.
author: AishwaryaN_Bangalore

title: Strong chemical smell
text: The mask has a very strong chemical/formaldehyde-like smell that gives me a headache during the 20 min application time. Results are okay but I cant tolerate the smell. Worried about what chemicals are actually in this. Natural/organic keratin masks dont smell like this.
author: PriyamvadaS_Gurgaon

title: Best oil for baby massage
text: My pediatrician recommended cold pressed coconut oil for my 6 month old's daily massage. PureRoots is the only brand I trust because its truly cold pressed and organic. No chemicals, no added fragrance. Baby's skin is so soft and healthy. Thank you PureRoots!
author: RanaP_Lucknow

title: Too heavy for oily skin
text: The cream is very rich and heavy. Good for dry skin types but on my oily skin it sat on top and made my face feel greasy. Woke up with clogged pores. I think they should make a lighter version for oily/combination skin. The ingredients are great though.
author: NamrataV_Mumbai

title: Good for daily use
text: Gentle enough for daily washing. Doesnt strip hair oils completely. My hair feels clean and light after use. Hairfall reduction is gradual but noticeable after 5 weeks. The 300ml bottle lasts about 2 months with daily use. Good value for money.
author: DineshS_Coimbatore

title: Using for wound healing
text: I use this raw honey for minor cuts and burns following Ayurvedic practice. The antibacterial properties of raw honey are well documented. PureRoots honey works beautifully for this purpose. Also great in tea. The quality is pharmaceutical grade honestly.
author: DrArunK_Varanasi

title: Serum is fine but delivery was 2 weeks late
text: Ordered through the app during a sale. The serum took 14 days to deliver. By the time it arrived the sale price was gone and I could have bought it faster from Amazon. The product itself is good but the app delivery is terrible. Fix your logistics.
author: SumanB_Patna

title: Expected faster results
text: Month 1 and I don't see much difference honestly. Maybe very slight thickening of existing hair but no new growth in patchy areas yet. The oil texture and smell are nice. Will give it 2 more months before final verdict. But for Rs 499 I expected quicker visible results.
author: JayD_Pune

text: meal prep sunday with @pureroots_official quinoa millet mix 🍚 made a big batch for the week - upma, khichdi, and salad bowls. so versatile and healthy! my fitness coach approved ✅💪 #mealprep #healthyeating
author: @fitfoodie_ananya

title: Fake product received
text: I think I received a counterfeit product. The texture, smell, and packaging are slightly different from my previous purchase. The holographic seal looks different too. Either this is fake or GlowNest changed their formula without telling anyone. Very suspicious.
author: MonikaT_Delhi

text: rain season hair hack: @urbanmane argan serum before stepping out = zero frizz even in Mumbai monsoon 🌧️ trust me on this. been using it for 3 monsoons now 💁‍♀️ #monsoontips #frizzfree
author: @hairstylist_nisha

title: Good quality, inconsistent batches
text: I've ordered 4 times. First 3 times the oil was excellent - pure aroma, right consistency. But this 4th batch tastes slightly different and the aroma is weaker. Seems like batch inconsistency issue. Quality control needs to be more uniform across batches.
author: VijayL_Trichy

title: Good cream, jar packaging unhygienic
text: The cream is wonderful and shows results. But the open jar packaging means you dip fingers into it every night which is unhygienic. Bacteria can grow in the cream. Please switch to a tube or pump dispenser. Product quality is 5 star but packaging brings it down.
author: DevikaS_Kochi

title: Scalp became very dry
text: After using for 3 weeks my scalp became extremely dry and flaky. The shampoo strips too much oil. I have normal scalp but this made it feel like desert. My hair actually became more brittle and started breaking. Had to switch to a moisturizing shampoo to recover.
author: PoonamG_Jaipur

title: My immunity booster
text: Having this every morning and night during monsoon season. Haven't fallen sick even once while everyone around me is getting cold and cough. The turmeric + pepper combo increases bioavailability of curcumin. Science backed and delicious. Win win!
author: SangeethaM_Madurai

title: Packaging feedback from a repeat customer
text: Hi GlowNest team, I'm a loyal customer who has bought your Vitamin C serum 6 times. The product is fantastic but I'm writing because the last 3 orders ALL had packaging issues - the dropper cap was loose and serum leaked. I've seen many customers complaining about this on Amazon too. As someone who loves your brand, please urgently fix the bottle cap design before you lose loyal customers. The product deserves better packaging. Warm regards, Kavita.
author: KavitaM_Pune

title: Effective but expensive per use
text: Each use requires a generous amount for medium length hair. The 200g jar lasts only 5-6 uses. At Rs 799 thats about Rs 130-160 per use which is expensive for regular maintenance. The results are great though - soft bouncy hair every time. Wish there was a bigger economical size.
author: ShivangiR_Delhi
